title: Aap par durood aur salaam aye mere imam
body:
Aap par durood aur salaam aye mere imam
<<MINI>>
(Ay mere imam) x2 aap par durood or salaam
<<DIVIDER>>
bas yahi sadaa hai subh ho shaam
<<MINI>>
(Ay mere imam) x2 aap par durood or salaam
<<DIVIDER>>
Aarahe hai aap chal rahi hai ye khabar
Khanaaye khuda pe hai tiki huwi nazar
Saj rahe hai raaste tamaam
<<MINI>>
(Ay mere imam) x2 aap par durood or salaam
<<DIVIDER>>
Har nafas tuje mera salaam arz hai
Mei to kya hu har nabi wali pe farz hai
Do jahaa me tera ehtiraam
<<MINI>>
(Ay mere imam) x2 aap par durood or salaam
<<DIVIDER>>
Do jahaa(n) ki baadshah teri zaat hai
tu hai uska haath jo khuda ka haath hai
tere haath bayyate tamaam
<<MINI>>
(Ay mere imam) x2 aap par durood or salaam
<<DIVIDER>>
isliye tumhara intizaar hai sadi
sar uthaye phir rahe hai waqt ke yazid
aake unse lije intikaam
<<MINI>>
(Ay mere imam) x2 aap par durood or salaam
<<DIVIDER>>
zikr khayr aap ka wazifa hai mera
manqabat nahi hai ye ariza hai mera
parh raha hu roz subh-o-shaam
<<MINI>>
(Ay mere imam) x2 aap par durood or salaam
<<DIVIDER>>
khana-e-khuda ko qayd se churayiye
maula jald aayi ab aa bhi jayiye
leke zulfikaar be niyaam
<<MINI>>
(Ay mere imam) x2 aap par durood or salaam
<<DIVIDER>>
mangte hai aur yu zuhoor ki duwa
dekhna hai humko intikaam-e-karbala
chahe phir wo zindagi tamaam
<<MINI>>
(Ay mere imam) x2 aap par durood or salaam
<<DIVIDER>>
gumte hai kawm aake sare aap ke
chal raha hai dekh ke nisaar aap ke
saare kayinaat ka nizaam
<<MINI>>
(Ay mere imam) x2 aap par durood or salaam
<<DIVIDER>>
author: Mir Hassan Mir
